Dragør is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report benchmarks clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the National Patient Registry (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Database (DanStroke) [^src1]. 

Dragør is specifically mentioned in the municipality-level data for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. Its performance metrics and patient counts for this indicator are recorded in a comprehensive table on page 93 of the report [^src1]. Beyond this single tabular entry detailing its stroke prevention metrics, no further claims, relationships, or historical timeline events regarding Dragør are documented in the provided corpus.
